gallery.title: File:Akkadian cylinder seal, late 3rd-millennium BCE. From Tell Kunara, Tanjro Valley, Sulaymaniyah, Iraq. Sulaymaniyah Museum.jpg
gallery.source: Akkadian cylinder seal, late 3rd-millennium BCE. From Tell Kunara, Tanjro Valley, Sulaymaniyah, Iraq. Sulaymaniyah Museum
gallery.description: Akkadian cylinder seal, late 3rd-millennium BCE. From Tell Kunara, or Gird-i Kunara, (season 1, 2012 excavations carried out by a team from the French National Center for Scientific Research), Tanjro Valley, Sulaymaniyah, Iraq. Sulaymaniyah Museum. Not on display. The impression reveals a deity (wearing a horned head cap) sitting on a chair. Before the deity, there is a low table; it seems that 2 objects are on the table. The deity greets 2 standing male figures. There is a star between the standing figures.
